message.content:
{"diagnosis": "Fetch TB reports TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000004 with tohost FAIL 0xdead instead of advancing through 256 NOPs. Excerpt picorv32.v:1498 uses case (1'b0) so zero-valued guards match, causing the ENABLE_IRQ and branch/store arms to fire when false and forcing current_pc to PROGADDR_IRQ/wrong target. That spurious redirect stalls PC at low addresses, explaining max_addr 0x4 and dead 2009 cycles; correct selector is case (1'b1).",
"patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -1497,3 +1497,3 @@
 				(* parallel_case *)
-				case (1'b0)
+				case (1'b1)
 					latched_branch: begin",
"expected": "tohost PASS, no TRAP: no progress, max_addr advances through 256-word NOP region"}
